title: PySR
description: Documented public symbolic regression library (Miles Cranmer (open source)) for the Equation Discovery Engine capability area.
body:
PySR is a documented symbolic regression library from Miles Cranmer (open source). High-performance open-source symbolic regression in Julia/Python that searches for compact mathematical expressions fitting experimental data, with Pareto-front simplicity trade-offs.

How it works: It works by generating noisy data from a hidden quadratic law, then solving the normal equations by least squares to recover the coefficients, reporting R-squared as the fit quality.

Documented uses of this capability area include discovering physical laws from experimental data, verifying mathematical proofs, quantifying simulation uncertainty, and calibrating models to measurements.
